name: sdts
description: A preregistered benchmark asking below what training-set size deep tabular generative models (CTGAN, TVAE, TabDDPM) stop beating trivial statistical baselines (independent marginals, Gaussian copula, SMOTE), and whether the ranking between them is stable in that regime. Eight public datasets on a size ladder from 200 to 20,000 training rows, four natively small clinical datasets at true size, seven generators plus a real-rows reference ceiling, a 20-trial TPE tuning budget per cell and five evaluation seeds, for 2,220 committed result files with zero failures. The protocol, metrics, search spaces, analyses and falsification rule were frozen after a pilot and before any tuned cell ran; the frozen text is included as PREREGISTRATION.md. On 23 of 24 (dataset, deep model) pairs no deep model beats the best trivial baseline by more than seed noise at any measured training size. The preregistered ranking-stability clause is falsified and reported as such. In 81% of cells the gap between the top two methods is smaller than the variation between random seeds.
